lastCompletedStory.title: Config reader for [models] and [backend] with defaults

nextStoryContext: US-001 is complete. src/config/models.ts exports readPhaseModel(phase, configPath?) and readBackend(configPath?) with DEFAULTS map. The configPath? param defaults to join(cwd,'scripts/cam/project.toml') and is the test seam. The existing project.toml only has issue_system and issue_prefix top-level keys; adding [models] and/or backend= to it will be picked up automatically. No toml.ts changes were needed (loadConfig handles missing files gracefully).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun.TOML.parse(input: string): object confirmed. Our usage in loadConfig matches the API.
